item.text:
Implemented a request-time server timestamp.

- [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:1) now calls `await connection()` before generating an ISO timestamp, following Next.js’s recommended [dynamic rendering approach](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/connection).
- [app/layout.tsx](/workspace/app/layout.tsx:3) metadata now reflects the timestamp page.
- `npm run build` passes and reports `/` as dynamically server-rendered (`ƒ`).
- Two production requests returned different timestamps, confirming per-request rendering.
